parserCandidates.notes: Low-level SMF parser/writer. Best semantic fit because it exposes raw MIDI structure without adding DAW/playback notation policy. Its published main entry is CommonJS, so an ESM/import-map-only browser pipeline needs a bundling/interoperability step.
Browser-friendly and higher-level, but already normalizes MIDI into Tone.js-oriented notes/times/instruments and itself depends on midi-file. This is more semantic opinion than Phase 14 needs.

A narrow in-repo parser can exactly implement the frozen SMF type-0/1 + PPQN subset and avoid CommonJS/browser packaging. Tradeoff: the project owns binary-parser correctness, malformed input handling, running status, VLQ, meta/SysEx/channel events, and security hardening.
primarySources: The MIDI Association Standard MIDI Files reference

recommendation.reason: The current browser delivery is import-map/ESM oriented and no existing bundler was detected. midi-file is semantically attractive but publishes a CommonJS main entry; adding a bundler solely for one dependency would enlarge Phase 14. A narrow internal parser for the frozen SMF 0/1 + PPQN subset keeps the runtime ESM-native and deterministic.
recommendation.fallback: midi-file only if a dedicated bundle step is intentionally introduced and validated

candidateModuleShape.officeDependencyRule: integrations/microsoft365 must not depend directly on @persian-braille/music
candidateModuleShape.sdkDependencyRule: @persian-braille/sdk may depend on @persian-braille/music and expose the public Music Braille facade
candidateModuleShape.semanticModelLocationRule: neutral music model is private/internal initially; freeze public SDK types separately before publication
candidateModuleShape.futureMusicXmlRule: future MusicXML parser is another private input adapter feeding the same semantic model

requiredInternalParserCapabilities: MThd validation and exact header-length handling
SMF format 0/1 acceptance and format 2 rejection
PPQN division acceptance and SMPTE rejection
variable-length quantity decoding with overflow/bounds checks
note-on and note-off including note-on velocity 0
meta events including tempo/time signature/key signature/end-of-track
truncated/malformed input failure without partial success
next: Phase 14.3b should materialize only the new music package foundation, raw SMF parser boundary, semantic types, and parser conformance tests according to the selected parser strategy. Do not implement Music Braille notation rules or Word UI yet.
